name: literature-workbench
description: Auditable literature retrieval, optional verified OA fulltext, Zotero workflows, and evidence-traced writing for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Retrieve, manage, and write from auditable evidence.
interface.longDescription: A three-skill literature workflow for source retrieval and ranking, optional OA-first verified fulltext jobs, lightweight Zotero project sync for reports plus selected papers, high-risk import and metrics plans, reusable English Agent Tags, explicitly requested Chinese-by-default AI Summary metadata, and evidence-traced scientific prose. Its bundled MCPs isolate fulltext and Zotero failure domains.
defaultPrompt: Check first-run API onboarding, explain the optional Zotero Web API, PubMed, and EasyScholar setup, and remind the user to install the Zotero Desktop XPI manually for AI4S columns and Priority controls.
Retrieve and rank PubMed evidence for my research question.
Create a reviewed Zotero import plan from selected ranked evidence.
Sync a finalized literature report and its selected papers into one Zotero collection.
Generate reusable English Agent Tags for a Zotero collection and clean its automatic source tags.
Generate one Chinese AI Summary sentence per Zotero paper from its title and abstract.
Draft an evidence-traced literature review section from ranked evidence.
